name: rovor-moho-local
description: Desktop-local ChatGPT bridge for private MP3-to-Moho render jobs.

interface.longDescription: A desktop-local bridge that receives one ChatGPT MP3 attachment, places it in a private Mac job spool, starts only a trusted local adapter, reports status, and exposes a verified MP4 resource. It never falls back to the Evan sprite engine.
interface.defaultPrompt: Send the attached MP3 to the local Moho render queue and report any setup blockers.
